children: Hong Kong technology firm's H1 revenue fell 48% compared to prior year period
Company posted net loss attributable to owners for the six-month period
Company did not provide specific guidance or outlook for future periods
METAL COMPONENT DEMAND – Revenue fell 43.8% to HK$18.9 mln as slowing demand cut metal industrial-component sales, outweighing higher smart helmet sales
ADMINISTRATIVE COSTS – Net loss widened to HK$9.8 mln from a HK$1.8 mln profit, primarily due to higher administrative expenses and lower finance income versus the prior year
KCT FAIR-VALUE LOSS – A HK$707.8 mln fair-value loss on Kuang-Chi Technologies shares drove other comprehensive loss
